project: Mario Kart Wii native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays a 50cc Grand Prix race at 60 fps (one short hitch at the start), no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: a 50cc race, 59.8 fps, no frame over 34 ms). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
